why_this_file_exists: The building catalog handoff has a writer (a Spark job over silver.building_register_titles) and a reader (the catalog.building projection command), and every name they must agree on lives here once — the same shape as building-unit-handoff.json, for the same reason (ADR-0072's prefix incident, guarded for the parcel copy by the-contract-names-where-its-objects-live).
manifest_object_reason: The source is an Iceberg table, so the export decides how many objects it writes; the manifest is written last and names each with its row count, and a loader that cannot find it refuses rather than succeeding at nothing.
partition_rule_reason: One object per five-digit PNU prefix, the grain both prior projections load at. Rows whose pnu is null cannot attach to a parcel and are not exported; the manifest carries their count.
columns_reason: Exactly the catalog.building columns the loader fills, minus the two it derives (id from register_pk, parcel_id from pnu) and the three rooftop columns the floor pipeline owns (ADR-0073 §5). Both sides read this list, so a column added on one is refused by the other until both moved.
